author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

This PR is technical. It moves the TICL reconstruction code into the `RecoTICL` subsystem, one package for each reconstruction step. It does not change an algorithm, a parameter, a module label or a product.

Today `RecoHGCal/TICL` holds all TICL plugins in one `plugins/` directory: seeding, cluster filters, pattern recognition, inference, linking, superclustering, interpretation, particle flow, dumpers and the sim-trackster producer. The CLUE layer clustering is in `RecoLocalCalo/HGCalRecProducers` for the endcap and in `RecoParticleFlow/PFClusterProducer` for the barrel. TICL now reconstructs the HGCAL endcap and the barrel, and this layout makes the code hard to follow.

| New package | Content |
|---|---|
| `RecoTICL/Common` | `TICLGraph`, `TrackstersPCA`, `TICLUtils.h` (shared library) |
| `RecoTICL/Geometry` | the `TICLGeom` EventSetup producers, `TICLGeom_cff.py` and their tests |
| `RecoTICL/LayerClustering` | `TICLLayerTileProducer` |
| `RecoTICL/ClusterFilters` | the cluster filters and `FilteredLayerClustersProducer` |
| `RecoTICL/SeedingRegions` | the seeding region algorithms, `TICLSeedingRegionProducer`, `TICLSeedingRegions_cff.py` |
| `RecoTICL/PatternRecognition` | CLUE3D, CA, FastJet, Recovery, `TrackstersProducer`, `MergedTrackstersProducer` |
| `RecoTICL/Inference` | the CNN, DNN and PFN inference plugins and the ONNX global cache |
| `RecoTICL/Linking` | Skeletons, FastJet and Recovery linking, `TracksterLinksProducer` |
| `RecoTICL/Superclustering` | the DNN and Mustache superclustering, `EGammaSuperclusterProducer`, `superclustering_cff.py` |
| `RecoTICL/Interpretation` | the General, GNN and Muon interpretation, `TICLCandidateProducer`, the momentum and track plugins, `MTDSoAProducer` |
| `RecoTICL/ParticleFlow` | `PFTICLProducer` |
| `RecoTICL/Configuration` | `iterativeTICL_cff.py` and the iteration cff files, next to pyTICL |
| `Validation/TICLValidation` | `TICLDumper`, `SuperclusteringSampleDumper`, `TiclDebugger` and their configuration |
| `SimCalorimetry/TICLSimProducers` | `SimTrackstersProducer`, `SimTracksters_cff.py`, `HLTSimTracksters_cff.py` |

`RecoHGCal` keeps only `RecoHGCal/Configuration`.

**Commit 2** moves the CLUE layer clustering to `RecoTICL/LayerClustering`: `HGCalLayerClusterProducer`, `HGCalLayerClustersFromSoAProducer`, `HGCalCLUEAlgo`, `HGCalImagingAlgo`, the Alpaka layer clustering producers, `BarrelLayerClusterProducer`, `BarrelCLUEAlgo`, the layer tiles headers, the `HGCalLayerClusterAlgoFactory`, `hgcalLayerClusters_cff.py`, `barrelLayerClusters_cff.py` and the `EtaPhiSearchInTile` unit test. The rechit producers, `RecHitMapProducer`, `MergeClusterProducer`, `HGCalClusteringAlgoBase.h` and `ComputeClusterTime` stay in `RecoLocalCalo/HGCalRecProducers`, so no `RecoLocalCalo` library depends on a `RecoTICL` library. The `RecoLocalCalo/Configuration` cff files do import the moved python modules, as they already imported `RecoHGCal.TICL.TICLGeom_cff` before this PR.
title: TICL restructure
